  • fvar names duplicate the FEA STAT's strings: fontc allocates fvar names before fea-rs adds STAT's, fontmake (per-master FEA) builds STAT first and varLib reuses its records (all referenced, harmless)
  • (to add or change, manually edit annotations.json)

annotations
  • fontmake's compatibility checker rejects masters whose anchor sets differ (sparse or duplicated anchors), which ufo2ft compiles fine; upstream never ran the checker and the VF builds with --no-check-compatibility: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288
  • fontc's per-master FEA merge rejects the sparse pole_1 master, whose features.fea only sets OS/2 values ('languagesystem statements differ from the default master'); ufo2ft compiles each master and varLib treats it as sparse: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1552

The shipped font was built from this source by an older ufo2ft, which silently kept the first glyph; needs a source fix: https://github.com/googlefonts/ufo2ft/pull/739

annotations
  • the AlegreyaSC instances' 'Rename Glyphs' swaps glyph data but not component references (quoteright.sc=quoteright leaves quoteright referencing itself), so fontmake fails 'cyclical component reference' on all 5 SC instances; static-only family anyway: https://github.com/googlefonts/glyphsLib/pull/1164
  • norad rejects more than 14 postscriptBlueValues, and glyphsLib writes a blue pair for every alignment zone into the instance UFO; 6.16.1 skips zero-height and duplicate zones, but Alegreya SC has 8 real ones (16 values). fontmake doesn't validate it: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/2241

annotations
  • norad rejects Newsreader72pt-Italic.ufo's kerning.plist because one pair's second side is an empty string (public.kern1.f -> ''), so fontc can't load the UFO; ufoLib loads it and ufo2ft ignores the pair
  • fontmake's compatibility checker rejects masters whose anchor sets differ (sparse or duplicated anchors), which ufo2ft compiles fine; upstream never ran the checker and the VF builds with --no-check-compatibility: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288

annotations
  • fontmake's compatibility checker rejects masters whose anchor sets differ (sparse or duplicated anchors), which ufo2ft compiles fine; upstream never ran the checker and the VF builds with --no-check-compatibility: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288
  • norad rejects Newsreader72pt-Italic.ufo's kerning.plist because one pair's second side is an empty string (public.kern1.f -> ''), so fontc can't load the UFO; ufoLib loads it and ufo2ft ignores the pair

tokotype/PlusJakartaSans/sources/config.yaml PlusJakartaSans.glyphs?18d1cd2f7e (default) ✎
view source repository copy reproduction command
annotations
  • the pinned source (newer than the shipped 2023 VF) has broken feature code: ss04's featureNames string has backslash-escaped quotes, and the @noexport class lists non-exported glyphs, which Glyphs.app drops but feaLib and fea-rs reject
  • a stray 8th 'Regular' instance at wght 200 redefines user 400 → 200; glyphsLib 6.16 then maps the Regular master to the interpolated 400, overwriting that point, but fontc only adds the default's point if new, keeps 400 → 200, and fails 'Missing mapping on Weight for default': https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans/issues/40

annotations
  • norad can't parse the designspace: stray <labelname> elements sit between <axis> elements directly inside <axes>, which serde reports as 'duplicate field axis'; fontTools ignores them
  • fontmake's compatibility checker rejects masters whose anchor sets differ (sparse or duplicated anchors), which ufo2ft compiles fine; upstream never ran the checker and the VF builds with --no-check-compatibility: https://github.com/googlefonts/fontc/issues/1288

annotations
  • gcircumflex and gmacron use different components in the 144pt Black masters (swapped order, spacing circumflex/macron instead of the combining marks), so the masters aren't interpolation-compatible; the shipped 2020 VF silently has no gvar for them: https://github.com/undercasetype/Fraunces/pull/275
  • norad can't parse the designspace: stray <labelname> elements sit between <axis> elements directly inside <axes>, which serde reports as 'duplicate field axis'; fontTools ignores them
